note: Y turns 'ad annos quinq; & quadraginta' into 'quinquaginta et quadraginta' and the Galen title 'ὅροι ἰατρικοί' into 'περὶ ἰατρικῆς'; X follows the print.
The texts are nearly identical, but Y prints 'charites' where the leaf reads 'charitas', and X keeps the printed form.
Y has 'qui loquámini' where the leaf reads 'loquímini' and 'Octavæ;' where it reads 'Octava;'; X matches both.
Y drops the sentence 'Dann sie muß höher im grad stehn/ dann die kranckheit', has many misreadings ('franckheit', 'Calentiam', 'sehen' for 'setzen'), and appends text from the facing page's margin.
X leaves out the whole line 'Misericordiam. Tot quondam populis terrisque superbum regnatorem asie' and garbles many words ('Cepariu casas', 'dauni'→'diutini'); Y reads the manuscript faithfully.
Y misreads 'Dies senis horis' as 'festis', 'C. XXIIII' as 'XXIII' and 'Nympharum' as 'Nymphas', and adds a 'Cap. XXXII' that the leaf does not have; X matches the print.
X is badly garbled ('auff ein stoß oder man' for 'oder zwen', 'Salniter' for 'Saltzstern', 'Es aber mehr em Salniter ist' missing 'stern der Eigenschafft'); Y follows the page closely.
X misreads 'fœtifico' and 'secundarum', drops 'eius' in 'succo eius reficiendo', invents Greek 'γυιανή', and makes up an ending ('Serpentes astuti') where the leaf breaks off at 'Ser-'.
X gets the folio wrong ('קטס' for 'קסב'), numbers verses 12–18 as 2–8, and misreads words ('לַחֹצְבִים' for 'לחטבים', 'עֲצֵי לָרֹב' for 'עצים לרב'); Y matches the spread.
X leaves out the clause 'cùm Sophron de mulieribus loquitur, tanquam de piscibus. Nam' before 'pisces videtur nominare'; Y has it and renders the Greek more accurately.
